title: Multiple appointments or nominations.
bodyText: If a respondent or other person makes more than one written appointment or nomination of a guardian or a conservator, the most recent controls.
bodyHtml: §560:5-117  Multiple appointments or nominations.  If a respondent or other person makes more than one written appointment or nomination of a guardian or a conservator, the most recent controls. [L 2004, c 161, pt of §1]
